name: Selenium
notes: The repository README addresses contributors and points users to the documentation on selenium.dev, the project website. The inspected tree holds the WebDriver bindings (java, py, rb, dotnet, javascript), the Java Grid server, the Internet Explorer driver (cpp/iedriver) and Selenium Manager (rust), a command-line tool that locates or downloads browsers and drivers. Selenium IDE, the record-and-playback tool also presented on selenium.dev, lives in the separate SeleniumHQ/selenium-ide repository. Agents use Selenium as an execution layer for browser actions; it contains no agent or model of its own.
summary: Browser automation project implementing W3C WebDriver, with Java, Python, Ruby, .NET and JavaScript bindings, Selenium Grid for spreading sessions across machines, and the Rust-based Selenium Manager for driver setup.
